segments.he: בְּיוֹם שֵׁנִי פָּרָשַׁת חֻקַּת הָיִינוּ עַל צִיּוּן ר' עֲקִיבָא וְעֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אֶלֶף תַּלְמִידָיו שֶׁמֻּנָּחִים בְּאוֹתוֹ הָהָר הַגָּבוֹהַּ, וּבְראשׁוֹ צִיּוּן רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, וּכְנֶגְדּוֹ מְעָרָה שֶׁל אֵשֶׁת רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, מִשָּׁם חָזַרְנוּ וְהָלַכְנוּ עַד שֶׁבָּאנוּ לִמְעָרַת ר' חִיָּא וּבָנָיו וְחָזַרְנוּ לְבֵיתֵנוּ:
segments.en:
And we prayed there. And we ate the morning meal there. Afterward they gave me money with honor. And Rabbi Leib traveled with me as far as Tcheirin. And I returned and came to Tcheirin on Wednesday — Parshas Terumah — about midday. And behold — I had already dispatched with Hashem's help the journey to these surrounding communities. And I did not need to travel anywhere else — only to Kremintchoug.

And behold — upon my arriving in Tcheirin a second time — the tossing about of the road already weighed heavily upon me.
